changelog:
Initial release of Kolect sentiment skill.

Provides a structured interface for AI agents to access and act on on-chain sentiment data.

Features:
- read normalized sentiment (BPS)
- check freshness and pending state
- request updates on demand

Part of the Kolect ecosystem:
https://kolect.info
https://x.com/kolect_info
summary: Query, check freshness, check pending requests, or request new sentiment updates on-chain for supported symbols and time windows via the Kolect Sentiment Fee...
